title: Declare a Nullable Variable
instructions:
Complete the program below.

1. Declare a nullable `String` variable called `allianceColor` and set it to `"Red"`.
2. Print the value of `allianceColor`.
3. Set `allianceColor` to `null`.
4. Print the value of `allianceColor` again.
hint: Use `var allianceColor: String?` to declare a nullable String. You can assign null to it because of the `?`.
